materials.name: Teachings of Charity
materials.desc:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Charity is the salvation of the frozen realm.
It is the love and vigilant care shared among mortals. Across this vast and boundless land, it is the warmth by which the people withstand the biting frost, soothing the deep-seated scars etched into their memories.

materials.name: Chimeric Core
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
This is the most fundamental core grown within a man-made monster. Yet, simple as it may be, it contains the primordial design for the growth of all man-made creations.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Guide to Fortitude
materials.desc:
Talent Level-Up Material.
Fortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.
It brings forth the will to grow. Though shattered by the bitter cold, a fragile seed can still harness this will to break through the frozen earth, pushing forth fresh sprouts to life across a landscape blanketed in wind and snow.

materials.name: Symbiotic Chimeric Nucleus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
A relatively complex core harvested from a man-made monster. This symbiotic nucleus is engineered to sustain the biological cycles of two distinct life-forms, seamlessly weaving them into a single organism.

Talent Level-Up Material.
Glory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.
It is the undying flame upon the beacon hearth, bound now to live or die with the frozen realm. The flame ignites a noble passion, and to sustain its eternal burn, the people would gladly offer up their all.

materials.name: Prime Chimeric Nexus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
The most complex core a man-made monster can possibly sustain, serving as an artificially engineered yet flawless seed of life. Whoever brought this creation into life has surely unlocked the very secrets of how life itself is shaped.

materials.name: Ascended Sample: Queen
materials.desc:
A rare sample resulting from the alchemical activation of a substance.
The "Queen" was once known as the "Minister," but as the rules of the game evolved, it grew to become the most powerful piece and a representation of the authority of the family behind the throne — a true symbol of gilded royalty.
Perhaps the promotion of an ordinary foot soldier shares some similarities with the transmutation of matter, yet even should they manage to turn to gold, the most a pawn might hope for is to be represented by an upturned rook.

desc.text:
Stabs at the opponent with the Traveler's weapon, which releases an ice-cold fog. This deals <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> to opponents up ahead and forms a Frostpierce Star next to the Traveler.
<color=#ffd780>Frostpierce Star</color>
· Follows your own party members around the field and periodically fires ice crystals at nearby opponents, dealing <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> : The Frostpierce Star will no longer fire ice crystals at opponents at intervals but will instead fire an ice crystal at opponents in a coordinated attack when the Traveler hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
· When an opponent is hit with an ice crystal, the Traveler gains 1 stack of <color=#ffd780>Frostglow</color> (max 8 stacks).
· When not in combat, <color=#ffd780>Frostglow</color> expires after 30s.
You observed the formation of frost together with Paimon.

Generates an ice javelin with the power of Cryo, then directs it at enemies to deal multiple instances of <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> .
When cast, the Traveler consumes all existing stacks of <color=#ffd780>Frostglow</color> , which in turn increases the DMG dealt by this Elemental Burst. When 8 stacks of <color=#ffd780>Frostglow</color> are consumed, the number of DMG instances caused by the javelins is also increased.
<color=#ffd780>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> : DMG from the current Elemental Burst is changed to <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.
You felt the keen edge of the icicles alongside Paimon.

attributes.key: Stellar-Conduct Ice Javelin Single Strike DMG
Stellar Swirl Ice Javelin Single Strike DMG
Additional Frostglow Attack Strikes at Stack Max

desc.text: <color=#ffd780>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> : When a <color=#ffd780>Frostpierce Star</color> is on the field, DMG from the Traveler's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion, and DMG dealt is also increased by 80% of the Traveler's ATK.
The Traveler's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of their ATK. Up to 160 Elemental Mastery can be gained in this way.

The Traveler will enter the <color=#ffd780>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a <color=#ffd780>Polestar Field</color> , or the <color=#ffd780>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.35% for every 100 points of the Traveler's ATK. A maximum 7% increase can be obtained in this way.

Draws new strength and power from their past travels: Every Elemental Type the Traveler has resonated with now grants an additional <color=#ffd780>enhancement effect</color> .
Additionally, when a nearby party member deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG, the Traveler gains 1 stack of "Icepoint." 1 stack of Icepoint can be obtained in this way once every 2s, max 3 stacks. When the Traveler unleashes a Charged Attack at 3 stacks of Icepoint, all stacks are consumed to change the attack into a special <color=#ffd780>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color>
· <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> dealt is increased by 140% of the Traveler's ATK, and the Traveler also gains 2 stacks of <color=#ffd780>Frostglow</color> .
· <color=#ffd780>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> can be unleashed once every 15s. Additionally, the DMG Bonus from the Ascension Talent "Ever-Keen Frost" does not apply to <color=#ffd780>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> : DMG from <color=#ffd780>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> is instead considered <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.

desc.text: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an <color=#ffd780>ice crystal</color> fired by the Elemental Skill <color=#ffd780>Ice Fog Piercer</color> .
Additionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.

Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#ffd780>Frostbound Javelin</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
The duration of the <color=#ffd780>Frostpierce Star</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#ffd780>Ice Fog Piercer</color> is increased by 25%.

Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#ffd780>Ice Fog Piercer</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

Every stack of <color=#ffd780>Frostglow</color> consumed when using the Elemental Burst <color=#ffd780>Frostbound Javelin</color> increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.
